headlines.title: Vance says the ‘real reason’ for GOP rout was anger over Iran war
headlines.description: Hours after Democrats routed Republicans in the midterm elections, Vice President JD Vance blamed his party’s losses on Americans’ frustration over the U.S. war with Iran, which has driven up oil prices at a time when costs are already high.

headlines.title: Ballot measure takeaways: Voters back abortion rights and voter ID
headlines.description: Nearly 150 ballot measures were at stake in more than three dozen states Tuesday.

headlines.title: Billionaire Leon Black sues Rep. Robert Garcia, alleging defamation over Epstein comments
headlines.description: Garcia is poised to be the next chair of the House Oversight Committee, which has subpoenaed Black as part of its investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.

headlines.title: Election results yield historic firsts
headlines.description: From state capitals to the halls of Congress, the elections resulted in a sea of fresh faces and a wave of firsts in political leadership across the country. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports on the history making changes.

headlines.title: Stock market surges on election results
headlines.description: Investors drove the DOW up more than three percent with bullish sentiment following Democrats’ historic win in the elections. NBC News’ Christine Romans explains what helped push markets higher.

headlines.title: Democrats take Congress in historic win
headlines.description: NBC News projects Democrats have won control of the House and Senate in the midterms. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Democrats won historic electoral victories on a pledge to make life more affordable, an issue that united voters across political and demographic divides.

headlines.title: Photos: Celebration and gloom at watch parties across the U.S.
headlines.description: Joy and despair punctuated election watch parties overnight after a blue tsunami swept the country’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: 5 healthcare fights Democrats could take on after midterms sweep
headlines.description: Democrats’ victories in the midterm elections could impact healthcare, from how much people pay for health insurance and prescription drugs to what coverage is available.

headlines.title: Mississippi Senate race heads to an extended vote count and possible ballot battle
headlines.description: The Mississippi Senate race may take days to resolve, as Democrat Scott Colom leads GOP Sen.

headlines.title: 5 things to know after election night: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to a special post-election edition of the From the Politics Desk newsletter!
